# transformation: parsed the embedded standard text into one "<section> <numeric-code>" pair per
#   line for 门类 (2-digit), 大类 (3-digit) and 小类 (4-digit) codes; names and notes dropped.
#   Sorted by section letter, then code. Counts: 20 sections, 97 大类, 473 中类, 1380 小类.
# verify: section ownership and sample codes cross-checked against the official standard DOCX at
